name: viridis-agent-reliability
description: Evidence-bounded reliability checks for MCP and A2A services

interface.shortDescription: Inspect MCP discovery and evidence boundaries.
interface.longDescription: Provides a bounded diagnostic workflow and an actual SecurityPreflight MCP connection for description and public receipt reads. Static artifacts and technical health do not prove runtime security, delivery, acceptance or usefulness. No signup or credential provisioning is included.
defaultPrompt: Run a reliability check on this agent endpoint.
Audit this MCP server before I connect it.
Check this A2A Agent Card and authority boundary.
